transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. I have authority to approve the final resolution package, but the current draft has several open items -- payment allocation, release scope, reference terms, and rehire status. Before we finalize our strategy, I'd like to hear from each of you on your areas of expertise so we can make informed decisions on those open terms. Who'd like to start?
